repair.title: Drowning Death Rates Fell
repair.summary: WHO reports that the global drowning death rate dropped by 38 percent between 2000 and 2021.
repair.why_it_matters: Prevention, safer environments, and better public-health attention can reduce a quiet cause of sudden loss.
repair.caveat: More than 300,000 people still died from drowning in 2021, and progress is uneven.
